title: Detailed trumpet
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <defs>
    <linearGradient id='brass' x1='0' y1='0' x2='0' y2='1'>
      <stop offset='0' stop-color='#FFE680'/>
      <stop offset='0.5' stop-color='#F5C542'/>
      <stop offset='1' stop-color='#C8901E'/>
    </linearGradient>
    <linearGradient id='brass2' x1='0' y1='0' x2='1' y2='1'>
      <stop offset='0' stop-color='#FFEE99'/>
      <stop offset='1' stop-color='#D9A22B'/>
    </linearGradient>
  </defs>
  <!-- bell -->
  <path d='M80 22 Q96 22 96 42 Q96 62 80 62 L70 58 Q76 42 70 26 Z' fill='url(#brass)'/>
  <ellipse cx='88' cy='42' rx='8' ry='20' fill='#FFE680'/>
  <ellipse cx='88' cy='42' rx='4' ry='14' fill='#FFF3BF'/>
  <!-- main tube -->
  <rect x='18' y='38' width='56' height='10' rx='5' fill='url(#brass2)'/>
  <rect x='18' y='39' width='56' height='3' rx='1.5' fill='#FFF0A8' opacity='0.7'/>
  <!-- mouthpiece -->
  <rect x='8' y='39' width='12' height='8' rx='3' fill='#F5C542'/>
  <rect x='5' y='37' width='6' height='12' rx='3' fill='#FFE680'/>
  <!-- valve casings -->
  <rect x='34' y='22' width='8' height='28' rx='3' fill='#F5C542'/>
  <rect x='46' y='22' width='8' height='28' rx='3' fill='#F5C542'/>
  <rect x='58' y='22' width='8' height='28' rx='3' fill='#F5C542'/>
  <!-- valve highlights -->
  <rect x='36' y='23' width='2' height='26' rx='1' fill='#FFF0A8'/>
  <rect x='48' y='23' width='2' height='26' rx='1' fill='#FFF0A8'/>
  <rect x='60' y='23' width='2' height='26' rx='1' fill='#FFF0A8'/>
  <!-- valve caps -->
  <ellipse cx='38' cy='21' rx='4.5' ry='2.5' fill='#FFF0A8'/>
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='21' rx='4.5' ry='2.5' fill='#FFF0A8'/>
  <ellipse cx='62' cy='21' rx='4.5' ry='2.5' fill='#FFF0A8'/>
  <!-- finger buttons -->
  <circle cx='38' cy='17' r='3' fill='#FFF3BF' stroke='#D9A22B' stroke-width='0.6'/>
  <circle cx='50' cy='17' r='3' fill='#FFF3BF' stroke='#D9A22B' stroke-width='0.6'/>
  <circle cx='62' cy='17' r='3' fill='#FFF3BF' stroke='#D9A22B' stroke-width='0.6'/>
  <!-- valve stems -->
  <rect x='37' y='19' width='2' height='3' fill='#D9A22B'/>
  <rect x='49' y='19' width='2' height='3' fill='#D9A22B'/>
  <rect x='61' y='19' width='2' height='3' fill='#D9A22B'/>
  <!-- lower slide -->
  <path d='M40 50 L40 62 Q40 66 44 66 L60 66 Q64 66 64 62 L64 50' fill='none' stroke='#F5C542' stroke-width='5' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <path d='M40 50 L40 62 Q40 66 44 66 L60 66 Q64 66 64 62 L64 50' fill='none' stroke='#FFF0A8' stroke-width='1.5' stroke-linecap='round' opacity='0.5'/>
  <!-- third valve slide -->
  <path d='M66 50 L66 58 Q66 62 70 62 L74 62 Q78 62 78 58 L78 50' fill='none' stroke='#F5C542' stroke-width='4' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- water key -->
  <rect x='52' y='66' width='2' height='4' fill='#D9A22B'/>
  <circle cx='53' cy='71' r='2' fill='#FFF3BF' stroke='#C8901E' stroke-width='0.5'/>
  <!-- finger hook -->
  <path d='M30 38 Q28 34 30 31' fill='none' stroke='#F5C542' stroke-width='2.5' stroke-linecap='round'/>
</svg>
